excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: That's with a single core. You can reconstruct data/proofs for multiple blobs in parallel. So for a system with 16 cores, you could reconstruct 16 blobs in 200ms too. The rust KZG lib has better parallelization support though & can reconstruct 1 blob's data/proofs in ~70ms (on my system with 16 cores) with parallelization.

excerpts.content: To be clear, I think a `DataColumnSidecar` with zero length column/commitments/proofs should be considered invalid. But we should also add an `assert len(sidecar.kzg_commitments) > 0` check to `verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof`. I'm going to work on a spec PR with these fixes today.
